notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello, Demons!

Patch 1.0.4 brings fixes for summon movement, boss balance, and a missing Dark blessing!

NEW

 Added Dark Blessing effect for Hex
 Added achievement for getting Hex's Dark Blessing


BALANCE

 Nerfed Vesper and Aldrics movement speed by 10%


BUG FIXES

 Fixed a bug where summons would fly off into oblivion when touching obstacles

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello, Demons!

Another small bugfix patch to fix an issue with statistics based achievements. My apologies for this error! Happy hunting!

Bug Fixes

 Fixes a bug where statistics-based achievements were erroneously only tracking the last played game's value rather than a running total.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello, Demons!

Here are the changes in From Hell v1.0.2

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the following weapons would not provide achievements appropriately on max level

 Horde of Bats
 Bone Dust
 Misericorde
 Death's Scythe
 Tentacle of Corruption

 Fixed an issue where Howl of Gehenna was improperly tracking DPS statistics
 Fixed an issue where users could not dismiss the Dark Blessing info screen via Spacebar when using keyboard controls


I hope you continue to enjoy the game!

notes.title: From Hell v1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello, Demons!

This update marks the release of From Hell v1.0.1, bringing the following small changes:

Tweaks

 Improved Enemy AI efficiency during late game
 Improved Melee and Range summon AI performance


New Features

 A direction indicator will guide the player towards the castle after vanquishing 3 bosses or after the 15 minute mark (but don't let that stop you! You can enter as soon as you like!)



These updates should help late game performance!

notes.title: From Hell Release!
notes.content:
Arise, Demons!
The fated day has arrived and FROM HELL is now available on PC, Mac, and Linux.
I hope you enjoy the game and have fortitude in hunting down some of the more difficult achievements.

You can find a thread for any bugs you encounter in the discussion group.

Now get to reaving!
